execution_policy.argv_path_policy: Executable and build output paths are repository-relative; every non-path argument and server HTTP_ADDR/GAME_IDS value is unchanged from execution metadata.

report_preservation.encoding: UTF-8 JSON followed by one LF
report_preservation.rule: Each report value is copied verbatim from the original one-line report.json, including its trailing LF. original_report_sha256 covers those original bytes.

limits: Local loopback observation with server and load generator competing on the same host.
One run per scenario does not establish maximum capacity or a latency guarantee.
RTT is applied game.action ACK round-trip time, not one-way or rendered-frame latency.
Uniform reservoir quantiles have no fixed error guarantee; maximum covers every observation.
Snapshot sequence gaps and capture-window evictions are not evidence of zero packet loss.
CPU utilization and RSS were not measured.
